episodes.title: First You Dream, Then You Die
episodes.summary: Widow Norma Bates and her shy teenage son, Norman, seek a fresh start in a coastal town filled with secrets; the arrival of an unexpected guest turns the Bates' lives upside down.

episodes.title: Nice Town You Picked, Norma...
episodes.summary: When Dylan arrives he immediately begins causing trouble; the Bates' are drawn into the secrets surrounding White Pine Bay.

episodes.title: What's Wrong with Norman
episodes.summary: Dylan learns there is more to his new job than he originally thought; Emma and Norman make a shocking discovery.

episodes.title: Trust Me
episodes.summary: Norma deals with distractions as her suspicions grow about certain town residents.

episodes.title: Ocean View
episodes.summary: Norma receives some much-needed help, while Norman desperately awaits his mother's return home; Emma and Norman follow more clues, leading to a big discovery.

episodes.title: The Truth
episodes.summary: Dylan asks Norman to move in with him; Norma warns Emma that some things are best kept to themselves.

episodes.title: The Man in Number 9
episodes.summary: The Bates Motel welcomes its first guest; Norman learns that popular girls come with many complications and Norma hires Emma to work at the motel.

episodes.title: A Boy and His Dog
episodes.summary: A mysterious stranger causes problems for Norma; Bradley is not happy when rumors spread at school; Dylan and Remo go on a fateful road trip; Norman takes up a grisly hobby.

episodes.title: Underwater
episodes.summary: Abernathy increases the pressure; Bradley and Dylan connect; Miss Watson encourages Norman's active imagination; Emma takes a trip.

episodes.title: Midnight
episodes.summary: Romero decides to take action; Norman brings Emma to the dance, but gets a ride home from Miss Watson.

episodes.title: Gone But Not Forgotten
episodes.summary: Norman fixates on Miss Watson's death; Dylan becomes involved in White Pine Bay's drug war; Bradley is driven to extremes as she searches for her father's killer; new romantic interests complicate the relationship between Norman and Emma.

episodes.title: Shadow of a Doubt
episodes.summary: Norma tries to distract Norman from his current obsession; Bradley needs help escaping from a dire situation; Romero is pressured to make an arrest; Dylan and Remo are kept on edge by a new worker.

episodes.title: Caleb
episodes.summary: Norma's brother Caleb arrives at the motel; Norma finds an ally in her efforts to prevent the bypass; Emma holds a memorial for a friend; a townie girl interests Norman.

episodes.title: Check-Out
episodes.summary: Dylan questions his loyalty to Norma and Norman; Christine introduces Norma to the town's social scene; Caleb's presence worries Norman; Romero is caught between Zane's war with a rival drug family.

episodes.title: The Escape Artist
episodes.summary: Norman shares a family secret with Cody; Dylan is caught in Zane's escalating war; Norma teams up with a mysterious man in an attempt to stop the bypass.

episodes.title: Plunge
episodes.summary: Dylan is asked to manage an explosive situation; Norma and Norman's relationship is threatened by a growing secret; Emma lands in a dangerous situation.

episodes.title: Presumed Innocent
episodes.summary: Norma's faith in Norman is questioned; Dylan is threatened by a revengeful Zane; Romero receives new evidence in the murder of Miss Watson; Cody and Norman's friendship reaches the breaking point.

episodes.title: Meltdown
episodes.summary: Romero digs deeper into the murder of Miss Watson; the conflict between the drug families leaves Dylan facing an impossible choice; Norma refuses to tell Norman the truth about his blackouts.

episodes.title: The Box
episodes.summary: Norma tries to connect with Norman. Meanwhile, Romero turns to a former colleague for help.

episodes.title: The Immutable Truth
episodes.summary: Norman is haunted by his past in the Season 2 finale. Later, Romero and Dylan try to bring closure to the drug war.

episodes.title: A Death in the Family
episodes.summary: Norman and Emma each make a decision about their future. Norma sets boundaries with Norman. An unexpected visit causes trouble in Dylan's fresh start.

episodes.title: The Arcanum Club
episodes.summary: Norman and Norma fixate on Annika's disappearance. Norma learns what the Arcanum Club really is. Dylan and Caleb encounter a new neighbor.Dylan and Caleb meet a new neighbor.

episodes.title: Persuasion
episodes.summary: Norman and Norma grow apart as Norman and Emma grow closer. Norma balks when Romero asks Norman some tough questions. Romero meets his competition for re-elections.

episodes.title: Unbreak-Able
episodes.summary: Norman and Emma take a day off from the motel. Romero investigates two mysterious deaths in White Pine Bay. Norma goes back to school. Buried secrets unravel for Caleb and Dylan.

episodes.title: The Deal
episodes.summary: When Norma finds herself in a rare position of power, she appeals to Romero for guidance. Norman and Dylan both come undone at the fallout of a secret. And Caleb considers an offer made to him by a surprising source.

episodes.title: Norma Louise
episodes.summary: Norma considers a life outside of White Pine Bay, leaving Norman in a vulnerable position. Dylan and Emma bond while helping Norman through a rough night. Romero is confronted by a new threat. And Caleb makes a difficult decision after learning of Norma's sudden departure.

episodes.title: The Last Supper
episodes.summary: Norma returns home to find a great mess waiting for her. Norman agrees to getting some help. And Dylan learns some shocking news about Emma's health.

episodes.title: The Pit
episodes.summary: Romero confronts Norma about new information recently come to light. Norman reels from a recent discovery. Caleb and Dylan take a job that involves some risk. And Emma makes a decision about her future with Norman.

episodes.title: Crazy
episodes.summary: Norman spends the day with a surprising visitor. Norma struggles to keep secrets contained. While at the farm, Caleb helps Dylan follow through on a good deed, but at a cost.

episodes.title: Unconscious
episodes.summary: Norma hits a breaking point with Norman's issues. Emma has a surprising reaction to seemingly positive news. Romero finally chooses sides, the decision sealing his fate in the town. And Caleb makes a decision that will uproot his new life.

episodes.title: A Danger to Himself and Others
episodes.summary: In the fourth season premiere, Norma searches for Norman; Dylan awaits news on Emma; and Romero gets a surprising proposition.

episodes.title: Goodnight, Mother
episodes.summary: Norma and Norman face off as they suspect each other of horrible actions; Dylan thinks about his future with Emma; and Romero makes a choice that will have a big impact on the Bates family.

episodes.title: 'Til Death Do You Part
episodes.summary: Norma and Romero take a big step; Norman struggles to accept his new circumstances; and Dylan tries to rid himself of old business.

episodes.title: Lights of Winter
episodes.summary: Norman goes on an adventure with a new friend; Norma gets a taste of happiness at a festival in White Pine Bay while Romero faces a potentially awkward situation; and Dylan is caught between two families.

episodes.title: Refraction
episodes.summary: Norman tries to confide in Dr. Edwards, but worries he may reveal too much. Also: Norma hires a craftsman to fix a window and Romero uncovers a crime that threatens his new life.

episodes.title: The Vault
episodes.summary: Norman digs into his past and confronts some painful truths; Norma tries to hide a secret of her own; and Romero puts his career at risk to help an old friend.

episodes.title: There's No Place Like Home
episodes.summary: A chance discovery spurs Norman to return home; Norma dives into new projects with Romero's help; and Dylan searches for Emma's mother, but has troubling results.

episodes.title: Unfaithful
episodes.summary: Norma is torn between Romero and Norman while Norman realizes how much everyone has changed in his absence.

episodes.title: Forever
episodes.summary: Norman and Norma try to reconnect as they plan for the future. Elsewhere, Romero and Dylan take action to help Norman.

episodes.title: Norman
episodes.summary: Norman plans a special event for Norma; Romero faces pressure due to his actions; and Dylan considers reaching out to Norman.

episodes.title: Dark Paradise
episodes.summary: Norman tries to keep up appearances despite a troubling discovery; Dylan and Emma receive a surprise guest.

episodes.title: The Convergence of the Twain
episodes.summary: Norman's date doesn't go as planned; Romero's frustrations reach a boiling point; Chick brings Norman a gift.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.summary: Norman helps Chick with a project; Romero makes his move; an apologetic Madeleine reaches out to Norman.

episodes.title: Hidden
episodes.summary: Norman learns who he can rely on as he attempts to protect his secrets; Romero struggles to find safety.

episodes.title: Dreams Die First
episodes.summary: Norman tries to piece together Mother's movements; in Seattle, Dylan and Emma confront an ugly truth; Sam's girlfriend, Marion, makes an impulsive decision with far-reaching consequences.

episodes.title: Marion
episodes.summary: A special guest checks into the motel; Dylan grapples with devastating news; Sam and Madeleine's marriage reaches a crossroads.

episodes.title: Inseparable
episodes.summary: Norman and Mother come together as trouble looms large; Romero convalesces with the help of an old friend; Dylan comes home.

episodes.title: The Body
episodes.summary: Mother uses tough love to protect Norman; Sheriff Greene begins a murder investigation; and Dylan gets his brother help.

episodes.title: Visiting Hours
episodes.summary: Norman's legal problems worsen; Emma tends to family business as Dylan gets caught between his past and his future; and Romero enacts his plan for revenge.

episodes.title: The Cord
episodes.summary: Norman comes home.
